name: D-Tools Cloud
description: D-Tools Cloud gives authorized users a read-only assistant for exploring business data from their D-Tools Cloud account. The MCP app can confirm the connected account, list accessible accounts, and ask D-Tools AI Advisor questions about pipeline, quotes, projects, clients, account health, procurement risk, and related operational data. Marketplace listings connect to production by default. Internal teams can validate dev, demo, and staging by creating provider custom connectors pointed at those environment URLs.

_published_faq.name: How do I add D-Tools Cloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add D-Tools Cloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.d-tools.cloud/api/v2/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the D-Tools Cloud MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: D-Tools Cloud provides these MCP tools: dtools_ask_advisor, dtools_get_connection_status, dtools_list_accounts, and dtools_concierge.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to D-Tools Cloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to D-Tools Cloud in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does D-Tools Cloud MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: D-Tools Cloud requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
D-Tools Cloud is developed by D-Tools. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
